list.name: survey
list.label: Опрос
list.query: SELECT title AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM surveys.survey_templates WHERE is_active = true AND kind = 'survey' ORDER BY title

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Всего отправлено"
FROM surveys.survey_sessions ss
WHERE ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ss.template_id = ${survey}

SELECT
  ROUND(
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss.status = 'completed')::numeric
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1
  ) AS "Заполнено %"
FROM surveys.survey_sessions ss
WHERE ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ss.template_id = ${survey}

panels.title: Среднее время заполнения
panels.description: Время от начала до завершения (completed_at - started_at)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM AVG(ss.completed_at - ss.started_at))::numeric, 0) AS "Секунд"
FROM surveys.survey_sessions ss
WHERE ss.status = 'completed'
  AND ss.started_at IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ss.template_id = ${survey}

panels.title: Среднее время до заполнения
panels.description: Время с момента отправки до завершения (completed_at - created_at)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM AVG(ss.completed_at - ss.created_at))::numeric, 0) AS "Секунд"
FROM surveys.survey_sessions ss
WHERE ss.status = 'completed'
  AND ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ss.template_id = ${survey}

SELECT
  date_trunc('week', ss.created_at) AS time,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss.status = 'completed')::numeric
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1
  ) AS "Заполнено %"
FROM surveys.survey_sessions ss
WHERE ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ss.template_id = ${survey}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT status AS "Статус", COUNT(*) AS "Кол-во"
FROM surveys.survey_sessions ss
WHERE ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ss.template_id = ${survey}
GROUP BY status

SELECT ROUND(AVG(sa.value_int)::numeric, 2) AS "Средняя оценка"
FROM surveys.survey_answers sa
JOIN surveys.survey_sessions ss ON ss.id = sa.session_id
WHERE sa.value_int IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ss.template_id = ${survey}

SELECT
  sq.title AS "Вопрос",
  ROUND(AVG(sa.value_int)::numeric, 2) AS "Средняя оценка"
FROM surveys.survey_answers sa
JOIN surveys.survey_questions sq ON sq.id = sa.question_id
JOIN surveys.survey_sessions ss ON ss.id = sa.session_id
WHERE sa.value_int IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ss.template_id = ${survey}
GROUP BY sq.id, sq.title, sq.sort_order
ORDER BY sq.sort_order

SELECT
  sa.value_int::text AS "Оценка",
  COUNT(*) AS "Кол-во ответов"
FROM surveys.survey_answers sa
JOIN surveys.survey_sessions ss ON ss.id = sa.session_id
WHERE sa.value_int IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ss.template_id = ${survey}
GROUP BY sa.value_int
ORDER BY sa.value_int

SELECT
  COALESCE(u.username, u.telegram_id::text) AS "Пользователь",
  sq.title AS "Вопрос",
  sa.value_text AS "Ответ",
  sa.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow' AS "Дата"
FROM surveys.survey_answers sa
JOIN surveys.survey_questions sq ON sq.id = sa.question_id
JOIN surveys.survey_sessions ss ON ss.id = sa.session_id
JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = ss.respondent_id
WHERE sa.value_text IS NOT NULL AND sa.value_text <> ''
  AND sq.question_type = 'text'
  AND ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ss.template_id = ${survey}
ORDER BY sa.created_at DESC
